title: A geometric Jacquet--Langlands correspondence for Shimura varieties
summary: We formulate a conjecture predicting the existence of exotic isomorphisms between Igusa stacks associated to different Shimura data whose underlying groups are pure inner forms of each other, and prove it in many cases of interest. In combination with the spectral action of Fargues--Scholze, this allows us to relate the cohomology groups of the two Shimura varieties, giving a geometric incarnation of the Jacquet--Langlands correspondence.
